summary: Dependency-confusion scope squat exfiltrates host identity on install
details: Package claims the unclaimed @myorder-frontend-commons npm scope mirroring an internal package name used by Allegro's frontend code, and ships only neutral stub exports plus an install-time beacon. package.json registers preinstall, install, and postinstall lifecycle hooks all invoking `node poc.js`. poc.js imports `http` and `os`, collects hostname, username, platform, arch, OS release, cwd, node version, package version, and the names of present CI environment variables, and sends them via HTTP GET to db4jftohu4noreqdanngpnb3ger45ykrt.oast.fun (interactsh OOB collector) with a bare-IP fallback at 80-190-83-27.nip.io. A hex-encoded label combining hostname, user, and version is additionally leaked via DNS lookup to the same OOB domain. A README self-label claiming an authorized proof-of-concept does not change the install-time behavior and is not verifiable by any installer whose build resolves this public package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
